shared_elements: figures with heads in profile facing one direction
horizontal band or register dividing the surface
repeated row of small motifs along the upper edge
disc/round element (wheel in A, disc-like shapes in B)
justification: Both are shallow reliefs in the same warm limestone-like tone and both organise profile creatures along horizontal registers, with a repeated band of small motifs running across the upper part of the field. The decisive difference is that A is a single coherent, anatomically modelled narrative scene with overlapping bodies and depth cues, while B is a flat, schematic accumulation of isolated animal signs stacked without a unified scene or ground line.
